headlines.summary:

headlines.title: 瑞银颜湄之：将2026年中国银行业收入增速预测上调至7–8%
headlines.summary: 【瑞银颜湄之：将2026年中国银行业收入增速预测上调至7–8%】瑞银亚洲金融机构行业研究主管颜湄之在中国银行业报告中表示，2026年上半年，中国无抵押消费信贷首次出现收缩，信用卡贷款和线上贷款是主要拖累，而银行消费贷款有所增长。瑞银预计2026年整体无抵押消费信贷将收缩，2027年持平，自2028年起每年小幅增长1%。她表示，中资银行的拨备重点正从房地产转向消费信贷，对中国银行业的压力测试表明，出现额外拨备可能性较低，因此，预计银行的每股股息将保持韧性，甚至可能上升。

headlines.title_en: UBS's Yan Meizhi: 2026 China Banking Sector Revenue Growth Forecast Raised to 7–8%
headlines.summary_en: [UBS Yan Meizhi: Raises 2026 China banking sector revenue growth forecast to 7–8%] Yan Meizhi, head of Asian financial institutions research at UBS, said in a report on China's banking sector that in the first half of 2026, China's unsecured consumer credit contracted for the first time, with credit card loans and online loans the main drags, while bank consumer loans grew. UBS expects overall unsecured consumer credit to contract in 2026, stay flat in 2027, and grow modestly by 1% annually from 2028. She said Chinese banks' provisioning focus is shifting from real estate to consumer credit, and stress tests on China's banking sector indicate a low probability of additional provisions; therefore, banks' dividends per share are expected to remain resilient or even rise.

headlines.title: 法兴银行：美国中期选举后，市场焦点重新转向基本面，美债避险吸引力料延续
headlines.summary: 法国兴业银行利率策略师在一份报告中表示，美国中期选举结束后，美国国债市场的关注焦点正重新转向市场基本面。其中，美国10月非农就业报告将于北京时间21:30公布。策略师表示：“油价下跌以及一项重大风险事件的消除，最初推动股市和债市同步上涨，但财政政策、美国国债发行、债务上限以及AI投资步伐等长期问题依然存在。在这一背景下，我们预计美国国债将继续保持避险资产吸引力。”策略师认为，财政刺激效应减弱、通胀趋于温和，以及风险资产阶段性波动，将在中期内支撑收益率温和下行、收益率曲线趋于平坦的市场环境。

headlines.title_en: Societe Generale: After US Midterm Elections, Market Focus Returns to Fundamentals; US Treasuries' Safe-Haven Appeal Expected to Persist
headlines.summary_en: Societe Generale rate strategists said in a report that after the US midterm elections, the focus of the US Treasury market is shifting back to market fundamentals. Among these, the US October nonfarm payrolls report will be released at 21:30 Beijing time. The strategists said: "Falling oil prices and the removal of a major risk event initially drove stocks and bonds to rise together, but long-term issues such as fiscal policy, US Treasury issuance, the debt ceiling and the pace of AI investment remain. Against this backdrop, we expect US Treasuries to continue to retain their appeal as a safe-haven asset." The strategists believe that weakening fiscal stimulus effects, moderating inflation and periodic volatility in risk assets will support a market environment of modestly lower yields and a flatter yield curve in the medium term.

headlines.title: 诺贝尔经济学奖获得者皮萨里德斯：中国经济正朝着正确方向发展
headlines.summary: 11月5日，第九届虹桥国际经济论坛发布《世界开放报告2026》，报告认为世界开放正处于复杂严峻的调整期，2025年世界开放指数为0.7453，同比下降1%，为2016年以来最大降幅。诺贝尔经济学奖获得者皮萨里德斯表示，地缘政治局势和关税壁垒对贸易秩序产生负面影响，关税出台逻辑早已不是经济考量；开放极大地提高了中国人民的生活水平，中国经济正朝着正确的方向发展。报告还显示，1990年至2025年中国开放指数从0.5891上升至0.7551，提高28.18%，2025年排名较2024年上升1位、较2008年上升32位、较1990年上升50位。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: Nobel Economics Laureate Pissarides: China's Economy Is Moving in the Right Direction
headlines.summary_en: On November 5, the ninth Hongqiao International Economic Forum released the World Openness Report 2026. The report holds that world openness is in a complex and severe adjustment period; the 2025 World Openness Index was 0.7453, down 1% year on year, the largest decline since 2016. Nobel economics laureate Pissarides said geopolitical conditions and tariff barriers have had a negative impact on the trade order, and the logic behind tariffs is no longer economic considerations; openness has greatly raised the living standards of the Chinese people, and the Chinese economy is moving in the right direction. The report also shows that from 1990 to 2025, China's openness index rose from 0.5891 to 0.7551, an increase of 28.18%; in 2025, its ranking rose 1 place from 2024, 32 places from 2008 and 50 places from 1990. (CCTV News)

headlines.title: 韩财政部召开半导体专家座谈会：AI需求未见萎缩，中长期增长依然有效
headlines.summary: 据韩联社报道，在美国中期选举后，围绕AI数据中心监管的担忧凸显并导致股市震荡的背景下，韩国企划财政部与半导体专家举行座谈，就相关产业动向及未来需求前景进行了检查。与会者综合评估认为，考虑到主要AI企业大规模投资的进展情况和未来计划，以及智能体AI普及带来的半导体需求扩大等因素，AI与半导体产业的中长期增长预期依然有效。他们研判称，尽管金融市场存在部分担忧，但目前尚未监测到会导致AI投资或半导体需求萎缩的明显信号。此外，考虑到韩国国内半导体企业长期供应合同的扩大等因素，预计短期内需求基础将保持稳定。

headlines.title_en: South Korea's Finance Ministry Holds Semiconductor Expert Symposium: AI Demand Has Not Shrunk, Medium- to Long-Term Growth Remains Valid
headlines.summary_en: According to Yonhap, after the US midterm elections, with concerns over AI data center regulation coming to the fore and roiling stock markets, South Korea's Ministry of Economy and Finance held a meeting with semiconductor experts to review industry trends and future demand prospects. Participants assessed that, considering the progress and future plans of large-scale investment by major AI companies, as well as the expansion of semiconductor demand brought by the spread of agentic AI, the medium- and long-term growth expectations for the AI and semiconductor industries remain valid. They judged that despite some concerns in financial markets, no clear signals have been monitored that would cause AI investment or semiconductor demand to shrink. In addition, considering factors such as the expansion of long-term supply contracts by South Korean semiconductor companies, the demand base is expected to remain stable in the short term.

headlines.title: 天孚通信：公司将适时研究并依法合规充分运用政策工具 维护公司价值与全体股东利益

headlines.title_en: Tianfu Communication: Company Will Study in Due Course and Fully Apply Policy Tools in Compliance with Laws and Regulations to Safeguard Company Value and the Interests of All Shareholders
headlines.summary_en: Tianfu Communication announced at midday that the company will hold a shareholders' meeting on November 9, 2026 to review the share repurchase plan. The company noted that the People's Bank of China issued on November 4, 2026 a policy to intensify the implementation of the relending facility for share repurchases and increased holdings, lowering the rate on the relending facility for share repurchases and increased holdings. The company will, in light of the repurchase relending policy, its own operating conditions and market trends, study in due course and fully use policy tools in accordance with laws and regulations to safeguard company value and the interests of all shareholders.

headlines.title_en: Morning news roundup
headlines.summary_en: The ChiNext Index fell 3.5% in the half-day session, with more than 4,500 stocks declining across the market. The Hang Seng Index fell 1.06% in the half-day session, and the Hang Seng Tech Index fell 1.75%, with MINIMAX and Zhipu down more than 8%. Yields on major Chinese interbank rate bonds fell rapidly, with the 10-year government bond yield hitting a record low. A tech-stock selloff swept Asia-Pacific markets, with South Korea's stock market plunging nearly 9% at one point and triggering a circuit breaker, while the Nikkei 225 fell more than 6% at one point. Zhongji Innolight, Tianfu Communication, Eoptolink, and Hygon Information announced: fully use policy tools in accordance with laws and regulations to safeguard company value. Trump said he will decide "soon" whether to restart a full-scale war with Iran, while diplomatic mediation is also accelerating. The governor-elect of Texas: work on data centers must be suspended until measures to protect the interests of the people of Texas are introduced.

headlines.title: 银河证券完成第一批A股买入操作 互换便利增量资金入市提速
headlines.summary: 【银河证券完成第一批A股买入操作 互换便利增量资金入市提速】记者了解到，截至11月6日，银河证券已执行第三批互换便利操作，成功办理第一笔回购融资，并完成第一批投资买入操作。银河证券表示，自2024年互换便利工具创设以来，公司便积极响应政策要求，高效推进互换便利相关工作，充分运用央行货币政策工具支持股票市场稳定发展，后续也将用足用好融入资金，持续开展权益市场的长期资产配置。今年11月3日，为支持资本市场健康稳定发展，央行开展机构进行第三批互换便利操作，整体意向申报额度超过1000亿元，31家券商、基金公司最终参与并中标，启动买入操作。市场普遍认为，在外部环境复杂多变、市场波动加大的背景下，机构踊跃参与互换便利，表明专业投资者对市场长期前景有信心，有助于推动增量资金入市、修复市场风险偏好。

headlines.title_en: Galaxy Securities Completes First Batch of A-Share Purchases; Incremental Funds from Swap Facility Enter Market Faster
headlines.summary_en: [Galaxy Securities completes first batch of A-share purchases; incremental funds from the swap facility enter the market faster] The reporter learned that as of November 6, Galaxy Securities had executed the third batch of swap facility operations, successfully completed its first repo financing, and completed the first batch of investment purchases. Galaxy Securities said that since the swap facility tool was created in 2024, the company has actively responded to policy requirements, efficiently advanced work related to the swap facility, and fully used the PBOC's monetary policy tools to support the stable development of the stock market; it will continue to make full and good use of the funds raised and continue long-term asset allocation in the equity market. On November 3 this year, to support the healthy and stable development of the capital market, the PBOC launched the third batch of swap facility operations for institutions, with total intended declared quotas exceeding 100 billion yuan; 31 securities firms and fund companies ultimately participated and won bids, starting purchase operations. The market generally believes that amid a complex and volatile external environment and increased market volatility, institutions' enthusiastic participation in the swap facility shows professional investors' confidence in the market's long-term prospects and helps drive incremental funds into the market and repair market risk appetite.

headlines.title: 《2026年世界贸易报告》中文版发布 呼吁修补和升级以WTO为核心的多边框架
headlines.summary: 第九届虹桥国际经济论坛分论坛——《2026年世界贸易报告》研讨暨中文版发布会11月6日举行，《2026年世界贸易报告》中文版在现场发布。中国世界贸易组织研究会会长马建春在主旨演讲中提到，《报告》通过严谨的模拟测算提供了极其严肃的预警：若不加干预，任由贸易体系走向碎片化，到2050年全球将面临巨大的机会成本——失去的潜在经济增量相当于全球实际GDP的5%到10%。历史已证明，规则一旦被破坏，重建的成本极其高昂。全世界需要的是修补和升级以WTO为核心的多边框架。

headlines.title_en: Chinese Version of the 2026 World Trade Report Released, Calling for Repairing and Upgrading the WTO-Centered Multilateral Framework
headlines.summary_en: The ninth Hongqiao International Economic Forum sub-forum—the Seminar on the World Trade Report 2026 and Chinese Edition Release—was held on November 6, and the Chinese edition of the World Trade Report 2026 was released on site. Ma Jianchun, president of the China Society for WTO Studies, said in his keynote speech that the report provides an extremely serious warning through rigorous simulation estimates: if left unchecked and the trading system is allowed to fragment, by 2050 the world will face enormous opportunity costs—lost potential economic gains equivalent to 5% to 10% of global real GDP. History has proven that once rules are broken, the cost of rebuilding them is extremely high. What the world needs is to repair and upgrade the multilateral framework centered on the WTO.

headlines.summary_en: It was learned from the National Development and Reform Commission's "Forging Ahead on the 15th Five-Year Plan" series press conference held today that China's oil and gas consumption currently accounts for about one-third of final energy consumption, mainly concentrated in transportation, industry and other sectors, and there is still significant room for substitution. headlines.title_en: Six Ministries: Accelerate Application of Frontier Technologies Such as Embodied Intelligence, Large Language Models, Brain-Computer Interfaces and Exoskeletons in Elderly Care
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Civil Affairs, the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Commerce, the State Administration for Market Regulation and the National Office on Aging issued Several Measures on Cultivating Diverse Scenarios to Promote Consumption of Age-Friendly Products. The measures propose promoting the application of smart age-friendly products. Driven by major national science and technology projects, accelerate the application of frontier technologies such as embodied intelligence, large language models, brain-computer interfaces and exoskeletons in elderly care, and develop and upgrade smart devices for care of disabled elderly, rehabilitation nursing and companionship.

headlines.title: 德国9月工业产出意外增长，工业复苏迹象显现
headlines.summary: 尽管伊朗战争推高能源价格，持续加重企业经营压力，德国9月工业产出仍意外增长。德国联邦统计局周五公布，9月工业产出环比增长0.7%，低于经下修后8月1.0%的增幅。此前，经济学家普遍预计将环比下降0.2%。这一增长为德国工业部门逐步复苏提供了新的初步迹象，尽管能源价格仍构成持续压力。9月工厂订单也大幅增长，而10月制造业采购经理人调查显示，行业活动进一步回升，但增速有所放缓。

headlines.title_en: Germany's September Industrial Output Unexpectedly Grows, Signs of Industrial Recovery Emerge
headlines.summary_en: Despite the Iran war pushing up energy prices and continuously adding to corporate operating pressure, Germany's September industrial production unexpectedly grew. The Federal Statistical Office announced on Friday that September industrial production rose 0.7% month on month, below the revised 1.0% increase in August. Economists had generally expected a 0.2% month-on-month decline. The increase provides new preliminary signs of a gradual recovery in Germany's industrial sector, although energy prices remain a persistent pressure. September factory orders also rose sharply, while the October manufacturing PMI survey showed further recovery in sector activity, but at a slower pace.

headlines.summary_en: The yield on China's 10-year government bond "26 Interest-Bearing Government Bond 16" fell 0.95 bp to 1.5790%, continuing to hit a record low. The yield on the 30-year government bond "26 Ultra-Long Special Government Bond 04" fell 1.45 bp to 2.0360%. The 30-year main contract of government bond futures rose 0.35% at one point.
